sentences.zh: 卡米尔，非常感谢你的来信。

sentences.en: It just brought me so much joy, and hi to Dolly Parton.
sentences.zh: 它给我带来了很多快乐，也向多莉·帕顿问好。

sentences.en: And then also, she went to Iceland, and she went to the Penis Museum, and she said the biggest
sentences.zh: 还有，她去了冰岛，去了阴茎博物馆，她说那里最大的是

sentences.en: one there is the sperm whale penis.
Here's a picture of her with it.
She sent a Polaroid, a tiny Polaroid, from the Penis Museum.
sentences.zh: 她寄来了一张拍立得，一张来自阴茎博物馆的小型拍立得。

sentences.en: This is her and Dolly, Dolly Parton.
sentences.zh: 这是她和多莉，多莉·帕顿。

sentences.en: What a great name for her cat.
I thought that was so cute.
Anyway, Camille, just thank you for your letter.
sentences.zh: 总之，卡米尔，谢谢你的来信。

sentences.en: Well, I love the reminder that we need to get to this Penis Museum.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很喜欢这个提醒，我们得去一趟那个阴茎博物馆。

sentences.en: We need to make this a real goal.
sentences.zh: 我们得把它定为一个真正的目标。

sentences.en: When we get determined and we set a goal, we make it happen.
sentences.zh: 只要我们下定决心设定目标，我们就一定能实现。

sentences.en: So I think we need to really make this a real goal.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们真的需要把它定为一个真正的目标。

sentences.en: Well, Josh wants to go to Iceland.
And I'm like, babe, I don't know if I can go there without Jenna.
sentences.zh: 我就跟他说，亲爱的，我不知道没有珍娜我能不能去那儿。

sentences.en: Am I coming on your family trip this year?
sentences.zh: 我今年要参加你们的家庭旅行吗？

sentences.en: Just for I'll pop over for one day of your family vacation.
sentences.zh: 我就在你们家庭度假期间过去待一天。

sentences.en: Well, I've got another place for us to go as well.
sentences.zh: 对了，我还有另一个地方想带你去。

sentences.en: We got a letter from Amanda B.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一封来自宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦的阿曼达·B的信，

sentences.en: in Allentown, Pennsylvania, whose daughter's name is Cece,
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，她女儿的名字叫西西，

sentences.en: And I want to thank you for including your photo of the Titanic Museum in Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 我想谢谢你寄来了田纳西州泰坦尼克号博物馆的照片。

sentences.en: Jenna is now obsessed with this Titanic Museum.
sentences.zh: 珍娜现在对这个泰坦尼克号博物馆着迷了。

sentences.en: It's like this immersive experience where you go on the boat and you learn all about
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种沉浸式体验，你可以登上那艘船，了解关于

sentences.en: the boat itself, which, Ang, come on, you love a ship.
sentences.zh: 船本身的一切，安吉，拜托，你可是最喜欢船了。

sentences.en: And then you learn about all the people who were on the boat.
sentences.zh: 然后你还能了解到船上所有人的故事。

sentences.en: And they have built a boat.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还造了一艘船。

sentences.en: I think they built something that looks like the inside of the grand staircase.
sentences.zh: 我想他们复刻了看起来像大楼梯内部的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, I want to see this Viking ship that they found at the bottom of the ocean and they
sentences.zh: 我是说，我想看那艘他们在海底发现的维京船，他们

sentences.en: rebuilt it and you can go see it.
sentences.zh: 把它重建了，你可以去参观。

sentences.en: We're going to go to it.
It was interesting to me too.
If we did a year of ships and we just went around and like looked at ships.
sentences.zh: 如果我们搞个“船舶之年”，到处转转，专门去看船。

sentences.en: Lady, we could do a year of trains.
sentences.zh: 女士，我们可以搞个“火车之年”。

sentences.en: There is a train ride I really want to go on.
sentences.zh: 有一趟火车之旅我一直很想去。

sentences.en: I mean, there's one that goes through Scotland that I've always wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有一趟穿过苏格兰的火车，我一直想去体验一下。

sentences.en: That's the first one that comes to mind.
sentences.zh: 那是第一个浮现在我脑海里的。

sentences.en: Also, I believe you're referring to the Osberg ship.
sentences.zh: 另外，我相信你指的是奥塞贝格号海盗船。
谢谢你，萨姆，或者说谷歌。

sentences.en: Seems like a wonderful place to visit.
sentences.zh: 听起来是个很棒的旅游目的地。

sentences.en: Well, Amanda B., if we make it to the Titanic Museum in Tennessee, it's because of you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，阿曼达·B，如果我们去了田纳西州的泰坦尼克号博物馆，那都是因为你。

sentences.en: So thank you for writing us.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你写信给我们。

sentences.en: Next up is the sweetest postcard that I got.
sentences.zh: 接下来是我收到的最贴心的一张明信片。
这是一张泰勒·斯威夫特的明信片。

sentences.en: And it's addressed to Angela Kinsey, head of the PPC, podcast queen, and fellow Swifty.
sentences.zh: 收件人是安吉拉·金赛，PPC负责人、播客女王，也是同为斯威夫特粉丝的你。

sentences.en: It's from Claire, and here's what she had to say.
sentences.zh: 这是克莱尔寄来的，她是这么说的。
克莱尔写道：安吉拉，感叹号。

sentences.en: It was so fun getting to meet you at NOLA.
sentences.zh: 能在新奥尔良见到你真是太开心了。

sentences.en: You know, she means New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她指的是新奥尔良。

sentences.en: You were so incredibly kind and gave me your blue Karma is a Cat friendship bracelet.
sentences.zh: 你当时超级亲切，还把你的蓝色“因果报应是只猫”友谊手链送给了我。

sentences.en: I think I may have blacked out when I met you because I was so excited that I fear I never gave you a bracelet.
sentences.zh: 我想我见到你时可能激动得大脑一片空白，因为我太兴奋了，我担心我当时没给你回赠手链。

sentences.en: I made one for you and Jenna as well.
sentences.zh: 我为你和珍娜也各做了一条。

sentences.en: I love your podcast and y'all's friendship.
sentences.zh: 我超爱你们的播客和你们之间的友谊。

sentences.en: Praising God that Jenna is cancer-free, and I made the pink bracelet for her.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝保佑珍娜战胜了癌症，我为她做了那条粉色的手链。

sentences.en: The other one matches your podcast cover photo.
sentences.zh: 另一条和你们播客封面的颜色很搭。

sentences.en: Wishing you all a blessed rest of your year.
sentences.zh: 祝愿你们余下的日子里一切顺遂。

sentences.en: I met her at the Taylor Swift concert, you know, the heiress tour in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 我是在泰勒·斯威夫特的演唱会上见到她的，你知道的，就是新奥尔良的时代巡回演唱会。

sentences.en: Well, Angela, you know, I went to Taylor's very last show in Vancouver with my daughter, and I love the Swifties.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你知道吗，我和我女儿一起去了泰勒在温哥华的最后一场演出，我真的很喜欢那些粉丝（Swifties）。

sentences.en: Isabel and I had the best time.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔和我度过了一段最美好的时光。

sentences.en: It was just an absolute, like, I mean, just overflowing of, like, joy and love.
sentences.zh: 那简直就是，怎么说呢，就是充满了喜悦和爱。

sentences.en: You know, a few people sent us friendship bracelets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人给我们寄来了友谊手链。

sentences.en: Sam and Cassie, you got yours as well.
sentences.zh: 萨姆和卡西，你们也收到了自己的那份。

sentences.en: Well, as we're finishing up this mailbag section, I did want to just shout out a few letters that were very meaningful to me personally.
sentences.zh: 那么，在结束这个信件环节之前，我想特别感谢几封对我个人意义重大的来信。

sentences.en: Several of you have written me about my cancer journey, but you've written me about your own.
sentences.zh: 你们中有几位写信给我谈到了我的抗癌历程，但也分享了你们自己的经历。

sentences.en: And I just – I don't want to share personal details of other people, but I want you to know that I have been reading each and every one.
sentences.zh: 我不想透露其他人的个人细节，但我希望你们知道，每一封信我都有认真阅读。

sentences.en: Jasmine, Amanda, thank you for your letters and for sharing with me about your journeys.
sentences.zh: 茉莉、阿曼达，谢谢你们的来信，也谢谢你们与我分享你们的经历。

sentences.en: And just all of you, I just want you to know that I'm reading them, and they are really comforting to me.
sentences.zh: 还有你们所有人，我只是想让你们知道我都在读，这些信真的给了我很大的安慰。

sentences.en: And you all sent me photos as well, and just thank you.
sentences.zh: 你们还给我发了照片，真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: And then Angela and I both wanted to just say thank you to Jamie D.
sentences.zh: 另外，安吉拉和我都想对来自北卡罗来纳州的杰米·D说声谢谢。

sentences.en: Jamie, you wrote us a card just talking about, you know, what happened in Asheville.
sentences.zh: 杰米，你给我们写了一张卡片，谈到了阿什维尔发生的事情。

sentences.en: After Hurricane Helene hit, and that you were part of that community and what that was like for you.
sentences.zh: 在飓风海伦袭击之后，你作为那个社区的一员，以及那段经历对你意味着什么。

sentences.en: And we just want to say that we're so glad that our podcast brought you some relief during that really trying time, which we know is still ongoing.
sentences.zh: 我们只想说，很高兴我们的播客能在那个非常艰难的时期为你带来一些慰藉，我们知道那段困难时期仍在持续。

sentences.en: And we're just – we're thinking of you, and we love y'all.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在挂念你，我们爱你们所有人。

sentences.en: And, you know, we thought we would end this top of show with a fun fan encounter.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们想在节目开头以一个有趣的粉丝偶遇故事来结束。

sentences.en: We know this about you, Ange.
sentences.zh: 我们了解你这一点，安吉。

sentences.en: If you come up and talk to me, I'm going to chat your ear off.
sentences.zh: 如果你走过来跟我说话，我一定会跟你聊个没完。

sentences.en: I hope you're not in a hurry.
And I was traveling through Austin, Texas a few months ago, and I met the nicest lady, and she told me such a sweet story.
sentences.zh: 几个月前我在德克萨斯州奥斯汀旅行时，遇到了一位非常好的女士，她给我讲了一个特别暖心的故事。

sentences.en: And I wanted to share it with you all on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我想在播客上和大家分享一下。

sentences.en: I said, hey, can you say it all again, and I'll record us?
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，你能再说一遍吗？我录下来。

sentences.en: So here – this is from my iPhone.
sentences.zh: 所以这里——这是我用iPhone录的。

sentences.en: Here I am in Austin, Texas in the ladies' room at the airport, and I just met –
sentences.zh: 我现在在德克萨斯州奥斯汀机场的女洗手间里，我刚刚遇到了——

sentences.en: And, Jamie, will you tell everyone what you just told me?
sentences.zh: 杰米，你能告诉大家你刚才跟我说了什么吗？

sentences.en: I had both my babies listening to your podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我让我的两个宝宝都在听你们的播客。

sentences.en: Like, while she was in labor, she was listening to office ladies.
sentences.zh: 她分娩的时候，居然在听《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: And then she was holding her baby as we were talking.
sentences.zh: 而且我们聊天的时候，她还抱着孩子。

sentences.en: And, you know, we weren't, like, in the bathroom stalls.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们当时又不是在厕所隔间里。

sentences.en: We were, like, in that little entrance part of – of course.
sentences.zh: 我们是在那个小入口处——当然了。

sentences.en: You know, that you walked through the little hallway.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是你穿过的那条小走廊。

sentences.en: And then we both exited the bathroom, and our husbands were both outside waiting for us.
sentences.zh: 然后我们俩都从洗手间出来了，我们的丈夫都在外面等我们。

sentences.en: And her husband was like, hey.
Because I was like, hey, I heard you guys listen to the office ladies.
sentences.zh: 因为我说，嘿，我听说你们听《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: He was like, man, we love office ladies.
sentences.zh: 他说，天哪，我们超爱《办公室女士》的。

sentences.en: Now, I've heard of people who watch The Office while they're in labor to distract.
sentences.zh: 我听说过有人分娩时看《办公室》来分散注意力。

sentences.en: But, oh, my gosh, she listened to office ladies.
sentences.zh: 但天哪，她听的是《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: Well, listen, why don't we take a break?
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，我们休息一下好吗？

sentences.en: And when we come back, I will dive into the fan theory.
sentences.zh: 回来之后，我会深入探讨那个粉丝理论。

sentences.en: Is Bob Vance part of the Scranton Mafia?
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·万斯是斯克兰顿黑手党的一员吗？

sentences.en: I can't wait to hear this because then I want to weigh in.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想听听这个了，因为我也想发表一下看法。

sentences.en: And are you ready to discuss, is Bob Vance in the Scranton Mafia?
sentences.zh: 你准备好讨论“鲍勃·万斯是否在斯克兰顿黑手党”了吗？

sentences.en: So when I was going through our digital mailbag, I came across this letter from Megan F.
sentences.zh: 当我翻看我们的电子信箱时，我发现了这封来自内布拉斯加州奥马哈市梅根·F的信。

sentences.en: I've been thinking about this for years.
sentences.zh: 这个问题我想了好几年了。

sentences.en: I am convinced that Bob Vance is either part of the Mafia or a lone shark.
sentences.zh: 我坚信鲍勃·万斯要么是黑手党成员，要么是个高利贷者。

sentences.en: Little sprinklings of information throughout the seasons ever since he first appeared has solidified my stance,
sentences.zh: 自从他第一次出现以来，几季中零星出现的信息让我更加坚定了这一立场，

sentences.en: and I would like to know where you ladies, as well as Sam and Cassie, stand on this take.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们几位，还有萨姆和卡西，对这个观点怎么看。
来自英国威尔士的泰根·B。

sentences.en: in Wales, UK, who watches The Office with her daughter, Bailey.
sentences.zh: 她和女儿贝利一起看《办公室》。

sentences.en: Tegan wrote in after we broke down the Mafia episode and said this.
sentences.zh: 泰根在我们解析完《黑手党》那一集后写信来说。

sentences.en: Hearing you guys take us through the Mafia episode, I had one question on my mind the whole time.
sentences.zh: 听你们解析《黑手党》那一集时，我脑子里一直有一个问题。

sentences.en: Have you guys heard the Bob Vance mob boss fan theory?
sentences.zh: 你们听说过“鲍勃·万斯是黑帮老大”的粉丝理论吗？

sentences.en: I thought it was ridiculous when I first heard it, but here is the Reddit link.
sentences.zh: 我第一次听到时觉得很荒谬，但这是Reddit的链接。

sentences.en: I would love to hear what you guys think on this one, especially after all the deep diving you guys did about mobs in Scranton.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你们对此的看法，特别是在你们深入挖掘了斯克兰顿的黑帮背景之后。

sentences.en: Well, I went to this Reddit thread.
It was part of the Dunder Mifflin Reddit thread.
sentences.zh: 那是邓德·米夫林Reddit帖子的一部分。

sentences.en: And it listed several reasons why Bob Vance might be in the Mafia.
sentences.zh: 上面列举了鲍勃·万斯可能是黑手党成员的几个理由。

sentences.en: And I'm going to go through them.
We also got mail from folks with ideas that I didn't see on the thread, and I checked those as well.
sentences.zh: 我们也收到了其他人的来信，提出了一些我在帖子里没看到的想法，我也一并核实了。

sentences.en: Bob Vance is actually in the Mafia and just tried to sell himself as a fridge salesman in this documentary so he'd look like a legitimate business in front of the public and the police who may be suspicious of him.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·万斯其实是黑手党成员，他在这部纪录片里把自己包装成冰箱推销员，好在公众和可能对他起疑的警察面前显得正当合法。

sentences.en: Starting with a letter we got from Kelly B.
sentences.zh: 先从我们收到的一封来自马里兰州安纳波利斯的凯莉·B的信说起，她说，

sentences.en: In Crime Aid, Bob doesn't even blink about bidding $1,000 to hug his wife.
sentences.zh: 在“犯罪援助”那集里，鲍勃为了抱一下他老婆，眼睛都不眨就出价一千美元。

sentences.en: Kelly also mentioned this talking head that was added to the Peacock Superfan episode of Branch Closing.
sentences.zh: 凯莉还提到了“分部关闭”那集的Peacock超级粉丝版里加的一段采访。

sentences.en: My fiancé, Bob Vance, he told me he'd give me a job at Vance Refrigeration.
sentences.zh: 我未婚夫鲍勃·万斯说他会在万斯制冷公司给我安排个职位。

sentences.en: I don't even have to come into work.
And I get paid in cash.
sentences.zh: 而且我拿的是现金工资。

sentences.en: Now that I say that out loud, it sounds illegal.
sentences.zh: 现在说出来，听着好像挺违法的。

sentences.en: I want you to know Phyllis smiles at the end of that.
sentences.zh: 我想让你注意，菲利斯在说完那句话后笑了。

sentences.en: After she realizes it might be a little illegal, she smirks.
sentences.zh: 在她意识到这可能有点违法后，她露出了那种笑容。

sentences.en: I think she's kind of turned on by this idea that Bob Vance has some sort of operation going where he can pay cash.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她是被鲍勃·万斯能搞到现金的这种操作给撩到了。

sentences.en: It might be illegal, but I think she's a little turned on by him breaking the rules.
sentences.zh: 这可能违法，但我认为她对鲍勃打破规则的行为感到兴奋。

sentences.en: That's what I took from it.
Because you're going to see in these clips that Phyllis is often throwing around things Bob will do or won't do.
sentences.zh: 因为你会在接下来的片段里看到，菲利斯经常拿鲍勃会做什么或不会做什么来威胁别人。

sentences.en: In fact, Kelly B points out that Phyllis has a talking head in season six, Happy Hour, where she talks about like going out with Bob Vance.
sentences.zh: 事实上，凯莉·B指出，在第六季的“欢乐时光”里，菲利斯有个采访片段，谈到了和鲍勃·万斯出去玩的事。

sentences.en: And she says, I tend to wear something low cut, get men to flirt with me.
sentences.zh: 她说，我倾向于穿低胸装，让男人们来调戏我。
然后鲍勃就会把他们揍一顿。
而且她又露出了那种笑容。

sentences.en: There are a number of episodes that reference Bob muscling people.
sentences.zh: 有很多集都提到了鲍勃动用武力威胁别人。

sentences.en: For example, when Karen comes to Scranton and she doesn't even know who Bob Vance is, she's like, who?
sentences.zh: 比如，当凯伦来到斯克兰顿时，她甚至不知道鲍勃·万斯是谁，她问，谁？

sentences.en: Phyllis tells her, you have a lot to learn about this town, sweetie.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯告诉她，亲爱的，关于这个镇子，你要学的还多着呢。
他才是这里的老大，姑娘。

sentences.en: And how about this clip from Secret Santa when Phyllis confronts Jim about wanting to be Santa?
sentences.zh: 还有“秘密圣诞老人”那集里，菲利斯质问吉姆想当圣诞老人的片段，你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: Don't make me get Bob involved.
sentences.zh: 别逼我把鲍勃牵扯进来。

sentences.en: He'd break both your arms, apparently.
sentences.zh: 显然，他会打断你的双臂。
还有来自北卡罗来纳州，目前住在夏威夷的凯特琳·S。

sentences.en: from North Carolina, who's currently living in Hawaii, wrote in to say,

sentences.en: But thank you, everyone, for writing in all your letters, all your theories, your questions,
sentences.zh: 但还是要感谢大家寄来的所有信件、各种理论、问题，
我们很喜欢听你们分享。

sentences.en: Lady, should we end with a key anecdote?
sentences.zh: 女士，我们要用一个关键轶事来结尾吗？

sentences.en: All right, here's a key anecdote from 2016.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这里有一个2016年的关键轶事。

sentences.en: people can't be excellent to you unless you're being excellent to yourself.
sentences.zh: 除非你善待自己，否则别人无法善待你。

sentences.en: When you're right, you're right, Keanu.
You cannot accept love into you if you are not already loving yourself.
sentences.zh: 如果你自己都不爱自己，你就无法接受别人的爱。

sentences.en: I think that's the perfect key anecdote to end this episode on.
sentences.zh: 我觉得用这个关键轶事来结束这一集再完美不过了。

sentences.en: Everyone, thank you so much, and we'll see you next week.
sentences.zh: 各位，非常感谢大家，我们下周见。
